chunks: and it dissolves stones in the bladder
and the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to eat melons with fresh dates
and in another report, he (peace be upon him) used to eat melons with sugar
and Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Eating melons on an empty stomach causes hemiplegia
and eating Al-Barni dates on an empty stomach could also cause hemiplegia
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits and risks of eating melons according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Khisal* underscores the Prophetic tradition of combining melons with dates or sugar, a practice rooted in the Shia understanding of balancing humoral qualities for optimal digestion. Al-Sadiq’s warning regarding hemiplegia (*falaj*) when eating melons on an empty stomach highlights the practical application of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine) in preventing specific ailments, linking dietary habits directly to neurological health.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: we read that they also help eliminate bladder stones.
God’s Prophet (MGB) used to eat melons with dates.
In another tradition it is reported that the Prophet (MGB) used to eat melons with sugar.
As-Sadiq (MGB) said, “Eating melons for breakfast would cause hemiplegia.
Eating Al-Barni dates for breakfast could also cause hemiplegia.”
